Subject: Cross-team acceptance criteria & playbook signoff

Team / Fiona,

Attaching the draft acceptance criteria and the proposed launch playbook for the Nimbus Payments early-access pilot. We need cross-functional signoff by end-of-day Wednesday (2026-09-16) so we can finalize the dry-run for next week. High-level gaps I want visibility on: 

- GTM / Sales: final pricing table and approved pilot discount (owner: Stephanie) — needed to lock outbound assets.
- Enablement: training modules + internal playbook (owner: Monica) — want at least one trainer dry-run.
- Docs: API quickstart + migration notes (owner: Laura) — require screenshots and code snippet checks.
- Support/CS: incident runbook and triage SLOs (owner: Rishi) — include on-call rotations for pilot.
- Ops: autoscaling test/pass, cold-start latency baseline (owner: Rishi) — must pass latency gate.

Action items I put into the spreadsheet (g2m-acceptance-criteria-v1.xlsx). Please update the status column in that sheet and reply with any blockers. For external stakeholders (Fiona / Nexus PS): we will provide the final playbook and support contact details after internal signoff.

Ask: everyone please reply with either "SIGNOFF" or "BLOCKER: <short note>" by EOD 2026-09-16. If blocker, include owner and mitigation plan.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Marissa —

SIGNOFF from infra/ops on the acceptance criteria items that are infra-dependent, with two notes: 

1) Autoscaling load test: we ran a 2-hour soak against the pilot configuration yesterday. We hit the target throughput but observed 20% higher P95 for cold-starts on large-context endpoints. Mitigation: enable prefix KV warm-up + reduce max sequence for background jobs. Ops will ship a runbook patch.

2) Monitoring/alerting: the default alert threshold for token-generation latency needs a slightly higher ceiling for the pilot to avoid noisy pages. I'll add a recommended threshold in the runbook diff (support-runbook-diff.pdf) and annotate the JIRA (INF-9876).

I'll attach the runbook diff and will coordinate with Support for on-call rotation for the pilot window. For now: SIGNOFF, conditional on Rishi -> ops delivering the runbook diff by 09/17 EOD.

Thanks for moving fast on this. I appreciate the clear owner calls and the conditional signoffs. My read: we are within an acceptable risk envelope for the pilot provided the following items land as committed: 

1) Stephanie confirms pricing table and pilot discount (pricing-scenarios-v2.xlsx) by 2026-09-17 COB.

Stephanie — please confirm the pricing item. If you need executive help on the discount, loop me in.
